help.title: Help & quick guide
help.lead: Pips & Paws is a fan tool for the tabletop RPG Mausritter: a character sheet, a Game Master dashboard and real-time multiplayer, all in the browser.
help.about.p:
Play a mouse adventurer by the official Mausritter rules (SRD 2.3.1): stats, hit protection, pips and experience, a grid inventory and dice — all on one page.
The Game Master view gathers a whole table: every mouse at a glance plus tools for running the session.
help.storage.p:
No account, no sign-up. Your mouse lives only in this browser's storage (localStorage) and is saved automatically on every change.
Export downloads it as a JSON file, Import brings it back — that's how you switch devices or keep a backup.
In multiplayer, game data flows directly between participants (WebRTC); there is no server recording anything.
help.sheet.p:
Every stat has a Current and a Max value. Damage lowers the current value; resting or healing restores it up to the max.
Save: click the die button on a stat to roll d20 — equal to or under the current value is a success.
Hit protection is the buffer before real damage. Pips are money. XP raises your level (and with it Grit) — the two are tracked separately.
The dice area at the bottom is free to use (d6, d66, saves) and writes to the log.
help.inventory.p:
Ten slots: 2 paws, 2 body, 6 pack. Drag items to rearrange or swap; dropping a one-slot item onto another swaps their places.
Large items take up two adjacent slots.
The small boxes on an item are usage dots (rations, spells, etc.) — click to mark them off.
Conditions are cards and take up real inventory slots until you delete them or mark them cleared.
help.multiplayer.p:
Under Multiplayer the Game Master opens a room and gets a 4-character code and an invite link. The GM's machine is the host.
Players join with the code or link — no account. Whoever joins sees their own sheet; the GM sees everyone.
Changes show up instantly for the others (losing HP, putting down an item …).
The host tab must stay open. Reloads and brief drop-outs are restored automatically.
help.gm.p:
Each player card shows stats, HP, armour, used slots, weapons and conditions. Below are actions: damage, heal, pips, XP, request a save or initiative, whisper, give an item or condition.
Shared stash: a common inventory — the GM drops loot in, players drag it onto their sheet.
Plus trackers for time, light and encounters, an NPC/combat tracker and GM notes.
Save session writes the stash, trackers and notes to a file.
help.rules.p: This app models the rules but does not replace the rulebook. The full, free Mausritter SRD and the original rules are linked here. Pips & Paws is an unofficial fan production and is not affiliated with Losing Games.
